subject: Possible to sort branches so clades usually stay together?

messages.author: e7014f74b5d49111
messages.subject: Possible to sort branches so clades usually stay together?
parts:
As in the image above, there are often cases where sorting the leaves would allow clades to stay together. I am not sure if there is a standard way to do it. I know iTOL does it by sorting based on number of leaves in a branch (see Leaf sorting under Display modes here). 

This seems like a nice feature. 

Also would there be a way to manually do this for cases like above where the Firmicutes appear to be invading the Bacteroidetes?

Thanks!

messages.author: 2ea9cb5e12a1a254
messages.subject: Re: Possible to sort branches so clades usually stay together?
parts: This is not a comment on the code to rotate clades, but it looks like flipping your firmicutes clades to "keep them together" would be disingenuous. If the branch separating them is supported then the firmicutes are paraphyletic for whatever character(s)/sequence were used to build the tree. The long branch makes the placement possibly dubious, but the topology is the topology.
